title: FLOODCAST_Predictions_Export_Schema
description: Provisional machine-readable JSON Schema for FLOODCAST / BASINSHIFT multi-horizon streamflow and flood hazard predictions.

catchment_id.description: 8-digit string identifier for the CAMELS-BR river basin gauge.

forecast_origin.description: Terminal timestamp of the 30-day antecedent observation window (YYYY-MM-DD).

target_date_1d.description: Forecast verification date at +1 day lead time (YYYY-MM-DD).

predicted_discharge_1d.description: Predicted daily streamflow at +1 day horizon in millimeters per day (mm/day). Non-negative float.

target_date_3d.description: Forecast verification date at +3 days lead time (YYYY-MM-DD).

predicted_discharge_3d.description: Predicted daily streamflow at +3 days horizon in millimeters per day (mm/day). Non-negative float.

target_date_7d.description: Forecast verification date at +7 days lead time (YYYY-MM-DD).

predicted_discharge_7d.description: Predicted daily streamflow at +7 days horizon in millimeters per day (mm/day). Non-negative float.

p95_probability_1d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P95 threshold at +1 day horizon.

p99_probability_1d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P99 threshold at +1 day horizon. Must be <= p95_probability_1d.

p95_probability_3d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P95 threshold at +3 days horizon.

p99_probability_3d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P99 threshold at +3 days horizon. Must be <= p95_probability_3d.

p95_probability_7d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P95 threshold at +7 days horizon.

p99_probability_7d.description: Calibrated exceedance probability of catchment climatological P99 threshold at +7 days horizon. Must be <= p95_probability_7d.

provenance.description: Source of historical input observations used for inference.
